description: Defines the ProjectActivity entity class with properties and methods related to project activities in the OrangeHRM system, including ORM mappings and relationships.

classes.name: ProjectActivity
classes.description: Entity class representing a project activity with ORM mappings, properties for ID, project, deletion status, name, and associated timesheet items, including getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the project activity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the project activity.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with this activity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the activity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the activity as deleted or not.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the activity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the activity.
